title: Winspace G5 frameset Australia
notes: Official regional page identifies the package as frame, full-carbon fork, FSA ACR headset and carbon aero seatpost, with a Toray T700 + T800 blend, UDH, T47 and FIDLOCK storage. Its 57 mm front and 52 mm rear clearance differs slightly from global/Japan rounding of 57–58 mm front and 53 mm rear.
